snippet.title: Fox Hunt • Playstation • Gameplay • HD
snippet.description: Gameplay of Fox Hunt (1996) for Playstation. I just discovered this game recently. A full motion video game from Capcom. One of the best in the genre in my opinion. It's got a lot of corny humor but its all part of the feel of the game. The main character makes me chuckle with his animated antics. Enjoy!
